title: Sherpa-UI views library
description: A page's Views, as JSON, by the id its View chip and the URL carry: the file a Context's views names in app.v1.json. The first is the Context's own. A View with `graph` is a graph View: its canvas shows one entity of that type, and the graph chip picks which (?graph=). loadViewLibrary() reads it, and leaves out one that is not a View.
